subject.title: feat(browser): normalize ChatGPT Work sessions to Chat

question: Should Oracle normalize every detected non-resume ChatGPT Work session to Chat and reject an explicit resume when the requested conversation is classified as Work?
rationale: The implementation is technically coherent, but this is an intentional compatibility policy that can replace an attached page or stop an existing resume workflow; repository history does not establish maintainer approval for that product boundary.

options.title: Approve Chat-only normalization
options.body: Adopt the proposed policy, reset non-resume Work attachments to Chat, and fail closed for explicit Work resumes.

options.title: Require an explicit opt-in
options.body: Preserve existing behavior by default and add a configuration switch for strict Work-to-Chat normalization and resume rejection.

options.title: Support Work directly
options.body: Pause this PR and define Work-compatible model, effort, and submission semantics instead of normalizing it away.

recommendation.title: Approve Chat-only normalization
recommendation.body: Adopt the proposed policy, reset non-resume Work attachments to Chat, and fail closed for explicit Work resumes.

likelyOwner.reason: The browser startup and resume architecture is predominantly tied to his current-main history, making him the strongest available owner for this compatibility policy.
